name: GMrepo_search_species
description: Search the GMrepo database for gut microbiome species by name. Returns species with NCBI taxon IDs, sample counts, prevalence across conditions, and number of associated phenotypes. Results are sorted by presented sample count and expose total_matches, has_more, truncated, and next_offset metadata for complete retrieval.

query.description: Species name or partial name to search. Examples: 'Akkermansia', 'Bacteroides', 'Lactobacillus', 'Faecalibacterium prausnitzii', 'Bifidobacterium'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset while has_more is true.

is_marker.description: True when GMrepo treats this species as a phenotype marker -- its `ismarker` flag, which is why a species is of interest in this database.

database_links.description: Links GMrepo holds for the species in other resources, e.g. {'dbtype': 'MVP', 'url': ..., 'anno': 'assoc w/ 2 phage clusters'}. GMrepo answers these as a JSON string rather than an array and they are parsed here; a string that will not parse is reported under `raw`. 25 of 50 microbes sampled carry at least one.

dbtype.description: The resource, e.g. MVP (Microbe Versus Phage).

url.description: Link to the species in that resource.

anno.description: GMrepo's note on the link, e.g. 'assoc w/ 2 phage clusters'.

raw.description: Present only when GMrepo's dblinks string would not parse; the string as sent.

name: GMrepo_get_phenotypes
description: List phenotypes and health conditions with gut microbiome data in the GMrepo database. Returns MeSH disease IDs, sample counts, and species/genus diversity. Results are sorted by valid run count and expose total_matches, has_more, truncated, and next_offset metadata for complete retrieval.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter phenotypes. Examples: 'diabetes', 'obesity', 'cancer', 'Healthy', 'Crohn'. Leave empty to list all phenotypes.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset while has_more is true.
